CIRCLE’s analysis of AP VoteCast found that voters aged 18 to 29 favored Harris by 51 percent to 47 percent in 2024. Four years earlier, the same age group had favored Biden over Trump by 25 points.

That shift was uneven. Young men preferred Trump by 56 percent to 42 percent, while young women backed Harris by 58 percent to 41 percent.
